summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Optimized Equity Income ETF (OEI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, aims to deliver steady monthly income through investments in US large-cap equities while employing an options overlay. The fund seeks long-term growth, with income as a secondary goal. OEI was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by Core Alternative.

holdings.infoBox: OEI is an equity ETF with a total of 103 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.87%, Alphabet at 5.87%, Apple at 4.55%, Microsoft at 4.24%, and Amazon.com at 4.10%.
